instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full-body shot from a slightly high angle. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the woman in a white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the left, facing right. She leans forward, extending her left arm to touch the chest of the bearded man in a black cap and dark polo shirt (R1), who stands on the right facing her. The room is illuminated by even overhead lighting, casting soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R2 leans forward toward R1 to initiate contact
R2 extends her left arm to touch R1's chest
R1 is the person receiving the chest touch from R2
R1 and R2 stand facing each other during the contact
R2's hand/arm contact is directed at R1's chest
